notes: Electrk's Player Throwing as a host rule: with nothing in your hand, click a player in your minigame (one your weapons may hurt) to lift them, limp, onto your hand, their bricks or tool put away and their camera circling you; hold fire to charge and let go to throw them where you look; they click to struggle free after a few seconds, and neither of you may take out a tool or bricks meanwhile. Its numbers come from this copy's script; its server preferences keep their defaults (on, minigames only, grab every 5 s, escape after 3 s, charged throws at 100 ms a notch, 2.5 times the charge). Not yet as in v20: the held body is not given its quarter turn on the hand (setTransform's rotation), and the orbit camera's zoom range is not used, only its starting distance.
